recognize_zh: 密集成片的小到中型淋巴球，核圓、染色質呈粗塊狀（soccer-ball / cracked-mud chromatin）、細胞質極少且淡藍；右下角混有一顆較大的細胞，右上可見一顆含顆粒的細胞，整體以單一小淋巴球為主，符合 CLL/SLL 浸潤。
features: Sheet of predominantly small to intermediate lymphoid cells, about 1-1.5 times red cell diameter
High N:C ratio with scant pale blue cytoplasm
Round to slightly irregular nuclei with coarsely clumped, block-like (soccer-ball) chromatin
Occasional larger cell (lower right) and a granulated cell (upper right) within the infiltrate
Several crushed/smudged nuclei in the cluster
describe_en: Smear (likely bone marrow aspirate or touch preparation) shows a dense cellular aggregate composed predominantly of small to intermediate lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio, scant pale cytoplasm, round to slightly irregular nuclei and coarsely clumped chromatin without conspicuous nucleoli. Occasional larger cells and scattered crushed nuclei are present, along with a rare granulated cell. Findings are consistent with involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma in the appropriate immunophenotypic context (CD5+, CD23+, dim sIg).

ddx.vs: Mantle cell lymphoma cells are often more irregular/cleaved with finer chromatin and lack the block-like chromatin, and are CD23 negative with cyclin D1/SOX11 expression.
Marginal zone cells have more abundant pale cytoplasm and may show plasmacytoid differentiation, and are typically CD5 and CD23 negative.
Follicular lymphoma cells have angulated, cleaved (buttock-like) nuclei and are CD10 and BCL6 positive, CD5 negative.
Reactive infiltrates are polymorphous with mixed T and B cells and lack a light chain-restricted CD5+/CD23+ population on flow cytometry.
